descriptions.itemBoomerang:
Flies out, bullies enemies for a while, then swings back for another round. 
No ammo needed, perfect for an eco-friendly loadout.
descriptions.itemBow:
Fires bargain-bin arrows when you quick draw. 
Bend it like you mean it to drop an explosive banger.
descriptions.itemDualRevolver: High fire rate, bad accuracy, yet one reload sends both revolvers soaring into explosive usefulness. A miraculous jump from meh to mayhem.
descriptions.itemMinigun: Once it spins up, this thing spews bullets nonstop. Technically stoppable, but you’re a full-time bullet-slinger, not some quitter.
descriptions.itemPistol:
Reliable at all times, average at everything. 
Peak choice for people who fear commitment.
descriptions.itemSheriffStar:
Launches at high speed and slice enemies. 
Justice has never been this low-effort.
descriptions.itemShotgun: Weirdly high fire rate for a shotgun, single-shell reloads, and a spread wildfires wish for. At last, a weapon that matches your aim.
descriptions.itemWinchester:
Crisp lever action, flawless precision, and rugged reloads. 
Once used to win sickly goldfish at the fair, now wins gunfights.
descriptions.itemUtilityAmmo:
Explodes into ammo. More players means more bullets. 
Family gatherings have never been so lucrative.
descriptions.itemUtilityBottleCrate:
Explodes into healing bottles.
Guaranteed to make you the most popular cowboy at the saloon.
descriptions.itemUtilityHealBottle:
Explodes on impact and creates a healing zone that lasts for a long time. 
Smells like rotten soup, just like any proper grandma’s remedy.
descriptions.itemUtilityImpulse:
Periodically generates shockwaves that push players away. 
Allows you to reach heights your skill level never will.
descriptions.itemSpellAcidBubble: Throw a big acid bubble that bursts on impact and creates multiple acid puddles
descriptions.itemSpellAcidContagion: Corrodes all enemies in a wide zone and applies Contagious, causing them to explode on death
descriptions.itemSpellAcidGeyser: Summon an acid geyser that erupts on impact and launches enemies into the air
descriptions.itemSpellAcidRain: Call down a rain of acid that corrodes enemies in a wide area
descriptions.itemSpellAcidThrower: Spit jets of acid that leave corrosive puddles on the ground
descriptions.itemSpellCactusDecoy: Summon a dancing cactus that lures enemies before exploding
descriptions.itemSpellCactusTurret: Summon a cactus turret that fires continuously at nearby enemies
descriptions.itemSpellCactusWall: Summon cactus spikes that damage and slow enemies on contact
descriptions.itemSpellElecPortal: Spawn up to two portals that teleport players and duplicate spell projectiles
descriptions.itemSpellFireSurcharge: Burn all enemies in a wide zone, detonating those already ablaze
descriptions.itemSpellFireWisp: Summon a wisp that deals extra burn damage, jumping to another enemy on kill
descriptions.itemSpellVoodooCorruption: Channel a doll to corrupt enemies, making them fight for you
descriptions.itemSpellVoodooDoll: Summon a doll that grants invincibility and high speed to allies within its zone
descriptions.itemSpellVoodooDrain: Command your doll to drain an enemy’s health
descriptions.itemShotgunFragment: Weirdly high fire rate for a shotgun, single-shell reloads, and a spread wildfires wish for. At last, a weapon that matches your aim.
descriptions.itemUtilityBottleCrateFragment:
Explodes into healing bottles.
Guaranteed to make you the most popular cowboy at the saloon.
descriptions.skinAnvil:
All jaw, no jokes. 
He once stared at a plank so long, the floor filed a complaint.
descriptions.skinBlink: He dreams of velvet curtains and standing ovations, but only found gunpowder and emergency extractions.
descriptions.skinCariboo: Snowman-crazed, he genuinely sees every enemy as a naughty snowman that needs discipline.
descriptions.skinGravekeeper:
Paid by the grave, so he’s weirdly rooting for the invaders. 
Not exactly the villagers’ favorite.
descriptions.skinHooty:
She’s revered as a pro tomb raider, but her career is accidental.
She just flipped a rock hunting mice and unearthed a temple.
descriptions.skinJaneDoe: Factory standard. The kind of girl who reads the instruction manual and highlights only the key details.
descriptions.skinMarauder:
He came for the Gold. He stayed because he got lost. 
He fights because he’s mad about it.
descriptions.skinOtto:
He loves bureaucracy and dreams of taxing bounty rewards.
Refuse to comply and he will promptly slap you in the face.
descriptions.skinPumpkinJack: Already the god of his own game, so he figured he might as well stroll in and wreck the Far Far West too.
descriptions.skinSheriff: He doesn’t move much. Or talk. Or blink. Honestly, we’re not even sure he’s alive, but damn, he looks cool.
descriptions.skinViejo: Cloaked in style, armed with tales, and older than he admits. Some say he’s fought in every war. All of them.
descriptions.skinWanderingTrader: She has killed more invaders than you ever will, yet she somehow stays humble.
descriptions.skinWillyBilly:
Need something fixed? He’s already halfway done. 
Need a friend? He’s been here the whole time.
descriptions.skinWoody: Half keg, half bomb, all unstable. He doesn’t talk much, mostly because any spark of conversation might set him off.
descriptions.emoteClap: When your teammate fumbles so hard you've gotta applaud.
descriptions.emoteCowboy: Gives big “I’ve trained for this in the mirror” energy.
descriptions.emoteDeadWeight:
Sometimes you carry the team. 
Today, you’re mopping the floor with your face.
descriptions.emoteFingerGuns:
Looks cool. Feels cooler. 
Unless you pair it with socks and sandals.
descriptions.emoteGuitar:
The ultimate morale boost.
Because everyone loves an unsolicited acoustic cover mid-fight.
descriptions.emoteHarmonica: A soothing tune to mark the loss of yet another teammate.
descriptions.emoteLasso:
Spinning like a cowboy, looking like a budget helicopter. 
And loving it.
descriptions.emotePrisiadki:
A tasteful tactical squat.
Widely recognized as the intellectual successor to teabagging.
descriptions.emoteRockingChair:
Sit and relax. 
The enemy can’t kill you if you’re already dead inside.
descriptions.emoteSalute: A proud salute to honor the mission that failed in record time.
descriptions.emoteTpose: It’s not a bug, it’s a feature.
descriptions.emoteWaitingsocket: Visibly judge your friend for taking forever in the lobby.
descriptions.mountNyxie: Born in the darkness, she spends her time standing dramatically in the rain, listening to the screaming of her own soul.
descriptions.mountRoach:
It will never give you up, never let you down. 
Unless there are monsters nearby.
descriptions.mountRodulph: Fired from reindeer duty for his awful flying, Rodulph now spends his days as a minimum-wage fairground horse.
descriptions.jokerAmmoSupply: +5% chance for enemies to drop an ammo box upon death
descriptions.jokerBattleMage: Killing an enemy shortens all ongoing spell cooldowns by 1%
descriptions.jokerBellShot: +5% chance for weakspot hits to summon a healing ghost bell
descriptions.jokerCactusDay: +3% chance for a Cactus Mino to spawn when an enemy dies
descriptions.jokerCamper: 50% chance not to consume ammo while standing still
descriptions.jokerCantRipOneTrick: Spells with base cooldowns of 35s or less have 20% reduced cooldown
descriptions.jokerChad: Reveals the position of the Wandering Trader and get a 20% discount. You deserve it
descriptions.jokerCheapSkate: Gain +1HP for every 20 Gold in your mission inventory
descriptions.jokerChickshot: +50% chance for bullets to make chicken sounds. Useless!
descriptions.jokerChonkyThrow: The boomerang is twice as big
descriptions.jokerClutch: The last 2 bullets in your magazine are explosive
descriptions.jokerConsumer: Grants +20% weapon damage, but reloading now wastes unused ammo
descriptions.jokerDeadlyStrong: Move faster and deal more damage as a dead ghost
descriptions.jokerDestroyer: The first 25% of your clip deals +15% damage
descriptions.jokerDisgrace: Gain +30% movement speed. Your horse does not want to be with you
descriptions.jokerDwarf: You are small. Gain Movespeed, Firerate and Lower gravity
descriptions.jokerEagleLever: Consecutive shots without missing grant +5% damage, stacking up to +50%
descriptions.jokerElementalSpin: The minigun has a 30% chance to fire a random elemental bullet instead of a regular one
descriptions.jokerFanningAce: Fire mid-reload at the right moment to chain-fire all bullets with low accuracy
descriptions.jokerFistFight: Your melee hits are twice as powerful
descriptions.jokerFocusShot: Every kill reduces the cooldown of your spells by 1 second
descriptions.jokerFrenzySpin: While your kill counter is above 10, the minigun fires twice as fast
descriptions.jokerGiant: You are big. Gain Health, Weapon Damage and Spell CDR
descriptions.jokerGlassCannon: +40% weapon and melee damage, but -25% HP
descriptions.jokerGoldProspector: Increase your acquired Gold by 20% at the end of a mission
descriptions.jokerGoldTooth: +10% chance for enemies to drop 1 gold nugget upon death
descriptions.jokerHeadshotRefund: +20% chance to get your bullet back after a weakspot hit
descriptions.jokerHealthyBoi: While at full HP, gain +20% move speed, reload speed, and fire rate
descriptions.jokerHeavyDrinker: Healing bottles are 25% more effective on you
descriptions.jokerHelpingHand: You can revive your allies twice as fast
descriptions.jokerHitMe: Heal 0.5 HP per second for 20 seconds after being hit
descriptions.jokerHoarder: +15% chance that collecting a Joker makes another random one appear
descriptions.jokerHomingBurst: Every 20 bullets fired, shoot 5 homing bullets at nearby enemies
descriptions.jokerJumpStar: +2 Jump while holding the Sheriff Stars
descriptions.jokerLastDance: While under 30% HP, gain +30% move speed
descriptions.jokerLazy: Ammo pickups are disabled. Passively regain ammos
descriptions.jokerLifePact: Kills heal you for 2 HP, but max. HP is reduced by 30%
descriptions.jokerLingeringThrow: Doubles the lingering time. Combines with Lingering Time upgrade
descriptions.jokerLuckyStrike: +10% chance to deal double damage per shot
descriptions.jokerMachineGun: Per mission, the weapon gains +0.3% fire rate for every 50 damage dealt
descriptions.jokerMagicFriendship: Passively regain HP while being near allies
descriptions.jokerMarkAce: Bullets mark enemies for 3s. Marked enemies take +15% damage
descriptions.jokerMindShot: Your weakspot hits cause an explosion
descriptions.jokerOverBlast: Shoot an extra pellet for every round missing from the magazine
descriptions.jokerPartyShot: +50% chance for weakspot hits to blow confetti. Useless!
descriptions.jokerPickPick: +5% chance on hit to spawn damaging pickaxes on the target
descriptions.jokerPigshot: +5% chance to spawn a pig on impact. Shoot them to make them explode
descriptions.jokerPlasticDuck: Walking makes rubber duck noises. Useless!
descriptions.jokerRage: Upon reaching 25% HP, release a wave that burns nearby enemies (cooldown: 60 sec.)
descriptions.jokerRampage: Killing an enemy grants 25% movespeed for 3 seconds (no stacking)
descriptions.jokerReloadMastery: Reloading an empty clip is 50% faster
descriptions.jokerRicochet: The fired bullet ricochets, with a 30% chance to automatically hit a nearby enemy
descriptions.jokerRushBlast: The first bullet in your magazine has 100% accuracy and shoots further away
descriptions.jokerScavengerStar: Gain +30% move speed and +100% pickup range
descriptions.jokerSecondWind: Heal 50 HP instead of dying to a fatal hit (cooldown: 180 sec.)
descriptions.jokerShroomGrave: +10% chance for a shroom to spawn when an enemy dies
descriptions.jokerSoulEater: Picking up a soul grants +20% damage and reload speed for 5s (no stacking)
descriptions.jokerSoulReaper: Increase your acquired Souls by 20% at the end of a mission
descriptions.jokerSoulSiphon: Increased pick up range and gain +2 HP when picking up a soul
descriptions.jokerSpeedster: Gives increased damage and fire rate the faster you are
descriptions.jokerStackedLever: Instantly reload 2 bullets from your reserve ammo on kill
descriptions.jokerStonks: +15% chance that opening a chest gives you a random Joker
descriptions.jokerSwampTrick: Reload explosions now leave puddles on the ground
descriptions.jokerToolBox: Utility pickups are disabled. Your utility automatically refills after 90 sec
descriptions.jokerTweakDealer: Gain +1 HP for each active Joker (including weapons)
descriptions.jokerWeakLink: Weakspot hits do 35% more damage, but regular hits do 35% less damage
